name: macys-marketing
description: Macys M3 MCP tools for compliance pre check, DAM lookup, and localization. Wraps the M2 functions and exposes them to the chained skills via the Model Context Protocol over stdio.

tools.name: check_pricing_conflicts
tools.description: Check a list of SKUs against MAP rules, active promo stacking, and catalog existence. Returns structured conflicts with severity.

sku_ids.description: List of SKU identifiers to check.

proposed_discount_pct.description: Proposed discount as a percentage, for example 40 for 40 percent off.

tools.wraps: M2 SKU pricing query plus the brand and stacking rules from PRICE-RULES-2026-001

tools.name: find_dam_assets
tools.description: Find DAM assets matching a category and region with currently active model release rights. Used to pull regional imagery for localized variants.

category.description: Top level category, for example Beauty, Apparel, or Home.

region.description: Region code, for example NY, CA, FL, TX, PR, or QC.

tools.wraps: M2 DAM finder (skills/dam-asset-finder), simplified to read from the seeded SQLite store for M3

tools.name: generate_locale_variants
tools.description: Produce a simulated localized variant of English campaign copy. Supports Spanish (es) and Quebec French (fr-CA). Does not call any external translation API.

regional_pricing.description: Optional pricing dict with currency and effective price. Appended as a line at the end of the variant.

tools.wraps: M2 localize_copy function, dictionary based transcreation
